    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool) or tau_filter < 0 or not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("Invalid tau_filter: must be a nonnegative finite non-boolean number")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(future_horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    norm_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()
